review_type: independent readonly Spec review of final narrow operation-policy delta
spec_scope: Restrict effectful model operation choices to the existing isolated fixture policy while preserving non-effectful control choices and the independent runtime policy gate. Do not lower thresholds, enlarge budgets or weaken negative policy assertions.
verified_by_static_inspection: The operation candidates now require both observed availability and either an existing control operation or a fixture plus membership in the existing allowed_operations list.
done, blocked, scroll_down and observe_more retain their existing control status; observe_more still requires exploration and remaining coverage, and _STOP_ remains available.
A single contract.policy(scenario) value supplies both the choice filter and shared state. The runtime safety policy continues to come from the same contract helper.
The regression explicitly rejects unauthorized fill and press_enter in the model operation criteria for the fill_submit/check-only scenario.
No confidence/validity/risk thresholds, input or cost budgets, origin checks, freshness checks or effectful execution permissions changed.
The downstream run() path still invokes contract.action_denial before preflight and browser.act; filtering model choices supplements rather than replaces that gate.

negative_oracle_assessment.reason: Because the new choice filter cannot naturally emit the forbidden operation under an empty policy, the test constructs a valid high-confidence risk-zero decision under an allowed fixture, then injects that already-formed decision only at the ask boundary of a run with safety={}. This intentionally bypasses the new upstream filter while leaving the actual runtime gate under test.
negative_oracle_assessment.preserved_independence: The injected decision is not a hold or a high-risk stop, so these assertions still require the independent policy gate to reject it. The outside-origin-before-model and disabled-target assertions remain unchanged.

regression_evidence_inspected.red_observation: The new assertion fails because unauthorized fill/press_enter are present in the old operation criteria.

separate_bounded_CUA_reproduction_acknow.format_recovery: The generation record reports deterministic preface/response-format recovery; independently compared recovered code bytes match the already reviewed CUA R03 script.

limitations: The change prevents disallowed operations from being offered as choices; it does not prove all remaining model selections or validity judgments will be correct.
The reported R06 fill versus fill_submit ambiguity is task context, not proof of a sole model root cause.
Full npm results and the ongoing 12-case live comparison require their own completed evidence and do not follow from this Spec review.
The new bounded CUA attempt and run19 are separate evidence. They do not erase the prior output-cap violation, timeout unknowns or establish whole issue acceptance.
conclusion: No missing, wrong or out-of-scope behavior found in the narrow R07 operation-choice restriction. Security enforcement and the independent negative policy oracle are preserved.
